title: Structure relaxation
action: Perform DFT structure relaxation for all required rocksalt hydride systems (RS-XH with X = La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu at 0 GPa; RS-LuH at 0, 1, 10 GPa; Lu4NH3 at 0, 1, 10 GPa) to obtain optimized lattice constants and atomic positions. Use the rocksalt (Fm-3m) or Pm-3m crystal structures as starting points.
description: Relaxed structures are required inputs for all subsequent calculations; lattice constants and internal coordinates influence N(E_F), phonons, and consequently Tc.

title: Electronic structure and density of states
action: For each relaxed structure, compute the electronic density of states (DOS) using a dense k-point grid. Extract the DOS at the Fermi level, N(E_F), in units of states/(spin·Ry·unitcell).
description: N(E_F) is one of the control parameters in the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula and is needed for the final scored output.

title: Phonon and electron-phonon coupling calculation
action: For each system, perform density functional perturbation theory (DFPT) calculations to obtain phonon dispersions and the Eliashberg function α²F(ω). Compute the total electron-phonon coupling constant λ and the logarithmic average phonon frequency ω_log.
description: λ and ω_log are the remaining parameters required for Tc estimation; their accuracy directly determines the computed Tc.

title: Superconducting Tc estimation and compilation
action: Using the McMillan-Allen-Dynes formula with Coulomb pseudopotential μ* = 0.1, compute the superconducting critical temperature Tc from λ and ω_log for every compound and pressure. Compile all computed superconducting parameters into a single CSV file with columns: compound, pressure_GPa, Tc_K, lambda, omega_log_K, N_EF_states_per_spin_Ry_unitcell.
description: Final assembled table of superconducting properties. The CSV contains all headline quantities (Tc, λ, ω_log, N(E_F)) for the full lanthanide series at 0 GPa, and for RS-LuH and Lu4NH3 at three pressures. The checker compares these values against paper-reported reference values and verifies required trends (monotonic increase of Tc with atomic number, pressure suppression, doping effect).
output_schema: CSV with columns: compound (string), pressure_GPa (float), Tc_K (float), lambda (float), omega_log_K (float), N_EF_states_per_spin_Ry_unitcell (float). Required rows include all 15 RS-XH (La, Ce, Pr, Nd, Sm, Eu, Gd, Tb, Dy, Ho, Er, Tm, Yb, Lu) at 0 GPa; RS-LuH at 0, 1, 10 GPa; Lu4NH3 at 0, 1, 10 GPa.
